audit_items.proof_trace: Repayment is enforced at two layers: market.repay_flash_loan (L837) asserts coin.value() == inner.amount() + fee (exact total), then reserve.repay_flash_loan (L245) reasserts coin.value() == amount (exact principal). The FlashLoan and ReserveFlashLoan structs lack 'drop' ability (hot-potato pattern), making repay_flash_loan the only possible consumer in the same transaction, so the assertions are unavoidable. Fee non-zero is also guaranteed: borrow-time (L814) and post-referral (L851) both assert fee > 0.
